notes.title: Patch 1.0.7.0 – UX Rework, Audio Settings, Texture Fixes, & Invert X/Y Option
notes.content:
Hey everyone! After a longer break, we’re back with Update 1.0.7.0, which brings long-requested UX improvements, audio options, visual fixes, and a more dynamic forest environment. Here's what’s new:

✅ New Audio Settings Menu
You can now adjust music, sound effects, and voice volume independently. This updated design offers much better control over your audio experience.

✅ Invert X/Y Axis Options Added
You can now invert the X and Y camera axis in the settings menu — another frequent player request.

✅ Box Puzzle Texture Fix (Low Settings)
Fixed a bug where symbols on the box puzzle were hard to see or completely missing when playing on lower texture quality. The signs should now display clearly. If any issues persist, please report them in the Discussions section.

✅ Animated Forest Environment
The forest is no longer static! We’ve added motion to the trees and leaves, making the environment feel more alive and immersive.

✅ Minor Bug Fixes
A handful of small bugs have been addressed to ensure a smoother gameplay experience.

🔜 Coming Next
🎧 Sound Designer Wanted
We’re currently searching for a talented sound designer to help us elevate the game’s overall audio feel.

🎮 Gamepad Support (80% Complete)
Full controller support is nearly done and should be ready in the next update.

🌿 UI & Vegetation Visual Rework (In Planning)
We’re exploring a full visual refresh of the in-game UI and vegetation layout to improve aesthetics and readability.

Thanks for supporting Code Alkonost! As always, your feedback helps shape the game — feel free to post suggestions or report bugs in the community.

Stay safe, and don’t trust the silence in the woods... 🌑

— Alkonost Team

notes.title: Patch 1.0.6.0 – Bug Fixes & Visual Improvements!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We’ve just released Patch 1.0.6.0, bringing important fixes and improvements to your experience in Code Alkonost. Here’s what’s new:

✅ Restored Flame Effects – No more missing flames! The fiery atmosphere is back.
✅ Fixed World Map Activation – The world map now properly loads without issues.
✅ Improved FPS Stability – If AI scaling is off, FPS is now locked to 60 FPS for smoother performance.
✅ Other Minor Bug Fixes – Additional tweaks for a better experience.

Thanks for your support! Let us know if you spot anything else. 🔥

notes.title: Update 1.0.5.0 – New Languages, Game Modes & Fixes!
notes.content:
Greetings, players!

We’re excited to bring you Update 1.0.5.0, packed with new language support, gameplay modes, and performance improvements. Here’s what’s new:

🔹 New Language Subtitles
We’ve added subtitle support for German, French, Italian, Spanish, Japanese, and Chinese! Now more players can enjoy the story in their native language.

🎮 Two Gameplay Modes
Modern Mode – Standard gameplay experience with guided hints and assistance.
Old-School Mode – No hints, no guidance! You’ll need to rely on your own logic and observation to solve puzzles and master mechanics. A true test of skill!

⚙️ Performance & Fixes
Fixed frame drops during boss fights, ensuring smoother gameplay.
Restored foliage in several levels that was previously removed due to technical issues, bringing back the original atmosphere.
We appreciate your support and feedback! Let us know how you like the new features.

⚔️ Good luck, and enjoy the game!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3.0 is Live!
notes.content:
Dear players,

We’ve just released Patch 1.0.3.0, bringing fixes, improvements, and new content based on your feedback!

Fixes:
- Glitches with torches, inscriptions, and candles not emitting light have been resolved.
- Vegetation rendering issues have been addressed.
- Audio problems reported by players have been fixed.
Improvements:
- New settings options for displaying player hints.
- Improved visibility of interactive items.
- New music tracks by Alkonost Band added to enrich the atmosphere.
Localization:
- UI has been translated into Serbian and Russian.
(Tutorials will be finalized and improved in the next updates.)

Performance Tips
If you experience performance issues, we recommend:
- Disable shadow settings.
- Switching to DirectX mode for better performance.

Technical Support:
While the game has been tested on over 20 different hardware configurations, we understand issues can still arise.
If you encounter any technical problems, please reach out to us – your feedback is crucial in helping us improve the experience for everyone.

What’s Next?
Our next update will introduce a game launcher, allowing you to configure settings directly from within the game, without needing to adjust them via Steam.

Thank you for your support and feedback – we are listening!

Alkonost Team

notes.title: First Update – Improvements Based on Your Feedback!
notes.content:
Dear players,

Thank you for supporting and playing Code Alkonost from day one! Your feedback has been incredibly valuable, and we’re excited to bring you our first major update, packed with improvements.

What’s New in This Update?
1. Gameplay Fixes and a New Tutorial
We’ve refined key gameplay mechanics to make the experience more intuitive and enjoyable. Additionally, we’ve added a detailed tutorial to help new players get started quickly and dive into the world of Code Alkonost with ease.

2. Level Design Improvements
Our level design has been polished to enhance the overall experience. We’ve added more detail, optimized transitions, and addressed issues affecting the flow of gameplay. Your adventures are now smoother and more immersive than ever!

3. Optimization for DirectX, Vulkan, and Steam Deck
This update includes major performance optimizations, ensuring a smoother experience on a wider range of devices. We’ve also worked specifically on Steam Deck compatibility, so you can now enjoy Code Alkonost on the go!

4. Achievements Fixed
We’ve resolved all issues related to achievements. If you’ve been chasing those badges, now’s the perfect time to dive back in and complete your collection!

For those of you who have already explored the world of Code Alkonost, we highly encourage you to give it another go. With these updates, your experience will be better than ever, and you might discover something new!

Thank you again for your support and for being part of our journey. Your feedback fuels our progress, so keep it coming!

Alkonost Team

notes.title: Code Alkonost Showcase video
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42595694/9a5bb54349a56991532ca68ffc4621e300c66fa3.png[/img]

Remote Human is excited to relevel new details for the upcoming single-player adventure survival-horror game Code Alkonost. The showcase presentation revealed details from the early stages of the development and includes game story details, game mechanics, game environments, concept art, a sample of the game soundtrack, and many more. Fans of horror games should prepare for a breathtaking experience because a free PC demo will be available as part of Steam Next Fest in October. However, this is not the first chance to get your hands on the game’s unreal Sanity Effect feature and take on the terrifying monstrosities that await inside the depths of the Slavic underworld because the game is available to playtest for free during Early Access via [url=https://discord.com/invite/aWcN9nQuQk]Discord server[/url].

[previewyoutube=vixGafn2KJw;full][/previewyoutube]

Here are a few details from the Code Alkonost showcase presentation:
 
[list]
[*] The main protagonist of Code Alkonost is a young Slavic girl who discovers her abilities and life purpose during her journey into the underworld. The game protagonist has no weapons or way to fight back. During her progress, she will reach that point of maturity where her body is abruptly changing and she will develop the confidence to make her own decisions, and resist attempts by unwanted creatures to take her soul and control over her own body.
[*] Immerse yourself inside dynamic and atmospheric environments, and learn how to use witchcraft to protect yourself from enemies. Learn about game characters and solve puzzles to progress further.
[*] Code Alkonost features unique content from an ethnographic museum and famous locations never seen in any game before. Scanned face models and voiceovers of real word actors that will provide a breathtaking cinematic experience developed using novel state-of-the-art technologies.
[*] Professional performers will provide voice-overs for video game creatures and create the feeling that someone is watching you.
[*] The Sanity Effect can impact the game's overall audiovisual experience by adding tension and fear inside the game environment. For an immersive experience and psychological effects, we use Unreal Engine 5.
[*] Playtester statement: Code Alkonost is an amazing experience, I wasn't aware that I am playing an indie video game, the unique gameplay and sanity effect is breathtaking and unpredictable, this product has many innovative features for horror gamers. 
[/list]
 
For more details check the showcase [url=https://youtu.be/vixGafn2KJw]video presentation[/url]  and provide a feedback via super quick survey.

For more information, visit Code Alkonost [url=https://codealkonost.com]website[/url], follow the title on [url=https://www.facebook.com/codealkonost]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.twitch.tv/codealkonost]Twitch[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/codealkonost/]Instagram[/url], and YouTube, support developers on Patreon and Ko-Fi, and join the community on [url=https://discord.com/invite/aWcN9nQuQk]Discord[/url]. Check out the latest screenshots from the Unreal Engine 5 playtest build via [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2062030/Code_Alkonost_Awakening_of_Evil/]Steam page[/url]. Players can look forward to a fully fleshed-out Code Alkonost experience when the first chapter of the game launches during Q1 2023.
